data.title: AI-assisted learning platform helps robots reason beyond literal commands
data.description: FLEX, a new AI-assisted learning platform developed by MIT engineers, enables motion-planning robots to follow a human’s explicit instructions while also drawing larger generalizations that help to improve its performance.
data.site_name: MIT News | Massachusetts Institute of Technology
data.keywords: MIT AeroAstro, MIT CSAIL, Andreea Bobu, Nathan Dennler, FLEX AI, household robots, natural language processing, motion-planning robots
